title: Pure Book
summary: The Book of Quick-Play Spell series (Book of Moon, Book of Eclipse, Book of Taiyou, and Book of Lunar Eclipse) paired with the Prediction Princess Ritual engine and classic Flip monsters (Magician of Faith, Morphing Jar, and Tsukuyomi). The deck repeatedly flips opposing monsters face-down to shut off Extra Deck plays while recycling its own Book Spells and Flip effects every turn.

summary.title: Starters
points: Pre-Preparation of Rites adds both Prediction Princess Tarotrei and Underworld Ritual of Prediction from the Deck to the hand.
Prediction Princess Bibliomuse revives itself in face-down Defense Position when Tributed for a Ritual Summon, and searches both a Prediction Princess monster and a Ritual Spell when flipped face-up.

Lord of the Heavenly Prison reveals itself in the hand to protect all Set cards on the field from effect destruction, then Special Summons itself when a Set Spell/Trap is activated to Set any Book Quick-Play Spell directly from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Pre-Preparation of Rites + Prediction Princess Bibliomuse
steps: Activate Pre-Preparation of Rites to search Prediction Princess Tarotrei and Underworld Ritual of Prediction.
Ritual Summon Tarotrei by Tributing Prediction Princess Bibliomuse from the hand or field; Bibliomuse immediately Special Summons itself from the GY in face-down Defense Position.

Use Tarotrei's Quick Effect (or Book of Taiyou) to flip Bibliomuse face-up, searching a follow-up Tarotrei and Ritual Spell while granting your Ritual Monsters targeting and effect-destruction protection.

summary.title: Flip-Cycle Loops: Magician of Faith & Morphing Jar
summary.text: Magician of Faith adds any Spell from your GY back to the hand whenever it is flipped face-up. Flipping Magician of Faith with Book of Taiyou or Prediction Princess Tarotrei recovers Book of Moon, Book of Eclipse, or Book of Taiyou itself, and Tsukuyomi or Tarotrei can then turn Magician of Faith back face-down to repeat the loop next turn. With Morphing Jar on the field, alternating Book of Taiyou and Book of Moon forces both players to discard their hands and draw 5 cards multiple times in a single turn.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Prediction Princess Tarotrei acts as both Book of Taiyou and Book of Moon as a Quick Effect on either player's turn, and revives any Flip monster from your hand or GY face-down in the End Phase.
Tsukuyomi flips any face-up monster on the field into face-down Defense Position when Normal Summoned or flipped face-up, then returns to the hand in the End Phase for reuse.
Underworld Ritual of Prediction banishes itself from the GY during the Standby Phase to Special Summon a Flip monster directly from the Deck face-down.

summary.title: The Book Spells
points: Book of Moon flips 1 face-up monster face-down, while Book of Lunar Eclipse discards 1 card to flip 2 face-up monsters on the field into face-down Defense Position.
Book of Eclipse flips all face-up monsters on the field into face-down Defense Position at once, shutting down an entire opposing board or resetting all of your Flip monsters simultaneously.
Book of Taiyou flips 1 face-down monster into face-up Attack Position immediately during your turn, firing off Magician of Faith, Morphing Jar, or Bibliomuse without waiting a turn.

allow.Magician of Faith: Flip Spellcaster that recovers any 'Book of' Quick-Play Spell from the GY when flipped face-up (including instantly via Book of Taiyou).
allow.Morphing Jar: Iconic Flip monster that discards both hands and draws 5 cards when flipped by Book of Taiyou and reset by Book of Moon.
allow.Tsukuyomi: Spirit monster that flips Magician of Faith or Morphing Jar face-down on Normal Summon to reuse their Flip effects every turn.
allow.Prediction Princess Tarotrei: Level 9 Ritual boss that flips a monster face-up or face-down as a Quick Effect and revives Flip monsters.
allow.Prediction Princess Bibliomuse: Level 9 Flip monster that searches Tarotrei and the Ritual Spell while granting targeting and destruction protection.
allow.Underworld Ritual of Prediction: Ritual Spell that summons Tarotrei and banishes from GY to summon a Flip monster from the Deck.
allow.Pre-Preparation of Rites: Searches Prediction Princess Tarotrei and Underworld Ritual of Prediction simultaneously.
allow.Lord of the Heavenly Prison: Protects Set Flip monsters and Set Book Quick-Play Spells from destruction and sets any Book Spell directly from the Deck.

main: Magician of Faith
Recovers Book of Moon, Book of Eclipse, or Book of Taiyou from the GY every time it is flipped face-up.
Morphing Jar
Resets both hands and draws 5 new cards; can be triggered multiple times per turn using Book of Taiyou and Book of Moon.
Tsukuyomi
Flips a face-up monster face-down on Normal Summon and returns to the hand during the End Phase.
Prediction Princess Tarotrei
Acts as a repeatable Quick Effect Book of Moon and Book of Taiyou on legs while reviving Flip monsters during the End Phase.
Prediction Princess Bibliomuse
Revives itself face-down when Tributed and searches Tarotrei + Ritual Spell when flipped face-up.
Lord of the Heavenly Prison
Protects all Set cards on the field and sets any 'Book of' Spell from the Deck.
Book of Moon
Classic Quick-Play Spell that flips any face-up monster on the field into face-down Defense Position.
Book of Eclipse
Quick-Play Spell that flips all face-up monsters on the field into face-down Defense Position.
Book of Taiyou
Flips 1 face-down monster on the field into face-up Attack Position, immediately triggering Magician of Faith or Morphing Jar.
Book of Lunar Eclipse
Quick-Play Spell that discards 1 card to change 2 face-up monsters on the field to face-down Defense Position.
Underworld Ritual of Prediction
Ritual Summons Tarotrei from hand or GY and banishes itself to summon Bibliomuse or Morphing Jar.
Pre-Preparation of Rites
